## Perform differential abundance analysis of pathways at KEGG Level1, level2 and level3

# 1. Aggregate abundant of pathways at KEGG level2

# Load packages
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# Import gene abundance data

```{r}
ko_abund <- read.csv("./Data/RPKM.KO.abundance_9353.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
colnames(ko_abund)[1] <- "KO"

# Annotation of each KO at Level1, Level2, Level3
ko_anno <- read.csv("./Data/kegg_pathway_annotation_info.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Extract KO column and rename the colname
ko_anno <- ko_anno %>%
  dplyr::rename(KO = 6) 

# Merge two tables based on "KO" colname
merged <- inner_join(ko_abund, ko_anno, by = "KO")
colnames(merged)

# -------- Level1 --------
abund_L1 <- merged %>%
  group_by(level1) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop")

# -------- Level2 --------
abund_L2 <- merged %>%
  group_by(level1, level2) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop")
abund_L2 <- abund_L2[,-1]

# -------- Level3 --------
abund_L3 <- merged %>%
  group_by(level1, level2, level3) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop")
abund_L3 <- abund_L3[,-c(1,2)]

# Export
write.csv(abund_L1, "./Output/KEGG_Level1_abundance.csv", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(abund_L2, "./Output/KEGG_Level2_abundance.csv", quote = T, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(abund_L3, "./Output/KEGG_Level3_abundance.csv", quote = T, row.names = FALSE)

```


# Perform differential abundance analysis on pathways at KEGG level2

# Load packages

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(effsize)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Since the following involves numerical calculations and the term “non-irrigated” contains a hyphen, we must use
# “nonirrigated”; therefore, we are using the new metadata table

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./Data/Metadata for level2 differential abundance analysis.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
comm01 <- read.csv("./Output/KEGG_Level2_abundance.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
comm <- comm01[,rownames(design)]

# Relative abundance
comm <- sweep(comm, 2, colSums(comm), "/")

# 1) Calculate mean / lower / upper

# transform into long table
df_long <- comm %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Function") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Function, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Abundance")

# merge data sets
df_long <- df_long %>%
  left_join(design %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample"),
            by = "Sample")


# 2) Perform a Wilcoxon test for each function

# no confidence intervals
wilcox_res <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Function) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = mean(Abundance[Irrigation == "irrigated"]) -
      mean(Abundance[Irrigation == "nonirrigated"]),
    cliff_delta = effsize::cliff.delta(
      Abundance[Irrigation == "irrigated"],
      Abundance[Irrigation == "nonirrigated"]
    )$estimate,
    p_value = wilcox.test(Abundance ~ Irrigation, data = cur_data())$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3) Filter by Significant Features
sig_res <- wilcox_res %>% filter(p_value < 0.05)

# 4) Calculate the statistic
summary_df <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Function, Irrigation) %>%
  summarise(
    mean  = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd    = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n     = n(),
    se    = sd / sqrt(n),
    lower = mean - se,
    upper = mean + se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5). Calculate “differences between groups”; # Convert to a wide table to make it easier to calculate the differences
diff_df01 <- summary_df %>%
  select(Function, Irrigation, mean, lower, upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Irrigation,
              values_from = c(mean, lower, upper))

colnames(diff_df01)
# Calculate the difference（irrigated - non-irrigated）
diff_df <- diff_df01 %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = mean_irrigated - mean_nonirrigated,
    lower    = lower_irrigated - upper_nonirrigated,
    upper    = upper_irrigated - lower_nonirrigated
  )


# Delete the “estimate” column from one of the two tables
plot_df <- inner_join(wilcox_res, diff_df[,-8], by = "Function") # 删除两个表格中其中一个estimate列

# Select the top 40 genes by absolute value of the estimate
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
  slice(1:40)

# Select the top 30 genes by absolute value of mean irrigated
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
  slice(1:40)


# Preparing the data for plot
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Model = Function,
    group = ifelse(estimate > 0, "irrigated", "non.irrigated")
  )

# reorder
plot_df$Model <- factor(plot_df$Model, levels = rev(plot_df$Model))
# Sort in descending order
plot_df$Model <- factor(plot_df$Model,
                        levels = plot_df$Model[order(plot_df$estimate)])
# export statistics
write.csv(plot_df, file = "./Output/KEGG_Level2_differential_abundance_analysis_results.csv")


# Add significance labels
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )


#  Plot
p1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = estimate, y = Model, color = group)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lower, xend = upper, y = Model, yend = Model), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +

  # Add significance stars on right
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 0.00185, label = sig),
    color = "black",
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(irrigated = "#4169B2", non.irrigated = "#BB2BA0")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.0012, 0.002), breaks = seq(-0.0012, 0.002, 0.0005)) +
  labs(x = "Effect size (Irrigated - Non-irrigated)", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black")
  )

p1
ggsave("./Output/KEGG leve2 differential abund_Irrigated abund top 40.pdf", p1, width = 10, height = 9)
```
